# Component index

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:index` (scripts/generate-component-index.mjs). Do not edit by hand: 
     src/__tests__/component-index.test.ts fails when this file is stale. -->

Every component-shaped (PascalCase, runtime) export of `@connorhoehn/ui-components`, grouped by job. Before writing any page or hand-rolling markup, find the component here. Import paths are the ones to use: each names a subpath where one exports the component, because a root import pulls the whole library into a consumer bundle. `AppShell` and `ThemeProvider` are on `/shared`; other layout components (`AppLayout`, `CollapsibleSidebar`) are root-only; there is no `/layout` subpath.

996 components across 21 entry points; 848 carry a one-line description from their source doc comment. Story ids are Storybook ids (`npm run storybook`, then `?path=/docs/<id>--docs`).

Also read: [`docs/consumer-adoption.md`](consumer-adoption.md) (decision tree and refactors), [`patterns/`](../patterns/README.md), [`skills/ui-page-build/SKILL.md`](../skills/ui-page-build/SKILL.md) (building a page) and [`skills/ui-dom-audit/SKILL.md`](../skills/ui-dom-audit/SKILL.md) (auditing one).

## Canonical choices

One component per common job. Reach for these first; the "don't use for" column is where the wrong pick usually happens.

| Job | Use | Import | Notes | Don't use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A new page (the default) | `PageFromSpec` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Describe the page as data (`PageSpec`: `template` → regions → `SectionSpec[]` → `LeafSpec[]`) and render it; `definePage(spec)` types it. Each leaf `kind` (`button`, `table`, `stats`, `form`, `tabs`, …) is one library component, so the page cannot contain hand-rolled markup. Reference: `docs/page-spec.md`. | Not for what a spec cannot express (a canvas, an editor): use the JSX template directly, or a registered leaf kind (`registerLeafKind` / `PageSpecProvider`) before reaching for `custom`. |
| App-defined leaf kinds | `PageSpecProvider` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Supplies components for the kinds an app declares on `PageSpecLeafKinds` (module augmentation), so they type-check in a spec; `registerLeafKind` does the same globally. | Not to replace a built-in kind (it throws); not for one-off markup (that is a `custom` leaf with a `reason`). |
| Frame for any page | `PageFrame` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | The outer frame of every routed page: title row, width and gutters. Use it (or a template built on it) instead of a hand-rolled `<div className="p-6 max-w-…">`. | Not for panels or drawers inside a page. |
| A list / collection page | `CollectionPage` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Title, description, header actions and a `CollectionToolbar` (search, filters, view switch) over the body. Pass rows as `table` (a striped `DataTable` with its `loading`/`empty`/`error` states) or a custom body as `children`; pass `gutter="page"` (its default is `none`). | Not for a list with a persistent detail pane (use `MasterDetailPage`) or a single record. |
| A list with a detail panel | `MasterDetailPage` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Selectable list on one side, the selected record on the other; owns selection layout; pass `narrow={{ onBack }}` for the narrow-screen form (under 40rem of its width the list, or the record under a back control, fills it; `ListRailLayout narrow` is the same for a hand-composed list rail). (`MasterDetail` is the lower-level rail + pane primitive it builds on.) | Not for a list whose rows navigate to their own route (use `CollectionPage` + `DetailPage`). |
| One record's detail page | `DetailPage` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Header with the record's title/status/actions, then **tabs** for the record's facets. | Don't stack a column of `Card`s for each facet; put facets in tabs and use `DetailSection` inside a tab. |
| A dashboard | `DashboardPage` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | KPI row plus a grid of chart/stat panels. Use `StatCard`/`KPIGrid` inside it. | Not the observability cluster dashboard: that is a different `DashboardPage` on the `/observability` subpath. |
| Pages inside a sectioned area | `SectionLayout` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Section rail (`items`, `railFold`) + optional list rail (`list`, `listFold`) + the content column: with `header`, the trail row (`trailControls`), the title band and a body whose `footer`/`ColumnDock` composer docks at the column's bottom; fills the viewport (`fill="viewport"`). Without `header` the child page template is the column. Pass `narrow` for a phone: `{}` turns the section rail into one scrolling row of links under 40rem of its width, `{ list: { showing, onBack } }` gives the list rail its narrow form too. | Not for one standalone page (use `PageFrame` or the matching template); not for a list + record with no section rail (use `MasterDetailPage`). |
| A settings page | `SettingsPage` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Section rail + settings content with consistent row spacing. (`SettingsLayout` is the lower-level shell.) | Not for a one-off form inside a modal (use the `forms/` controls in a `Modal`). |
| App chrome | `AppShell` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Sidebar + top bar + content region. Pass `layout="fill"` when the content area must fill the viewport (canvases, chat, editors) rather than scroll as a document. | Not inside a page; there is exactly one per app. Import it (and `ThemeProvider`) from `/shared`; there is no `/layout` subpath. |
| A data table | `DataTable` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Columns + rows with sorting, selection, empty/loading states and row striping by default. Start here for any tabular data. Pass `narrow` for the card form: under 40rem of its own width each row stacks into label/value pairs (`label` per column) instead of scrolling sideways. Pass `responsiveColumns` with `columns[].priority` (1 = always shown, higher numbers hide first) to drop columns as its own width narrows until the rest fit, with a "+N columns" popover per row for the hidden values (or `hiddenColumnsControl="header"`: one control in the "More" header and a chevron per row). | Don't drop to `Table` primitives unless you need cell layouts `DataTable` cannot express. |
| Table building blocks | `Table` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | `Table`, `TableHead`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableTh`, `TableTd`: the styled primitives `DataTable` is made of. | Not a first choice: no sorting, selection or states built in. |
| Identity admin tables | `EntityTable` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/identity` | The identity-admin entity list (users, groups, roles) with row actions. | Not a general-purpose table; use `DataTable` outside identity admin. |
| Separate sections | `SectionStack` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Stacks a page's sections with a full-width hairline between each (none before the first or after the last; skips null children). `Divider` is a single (optionally captioned) hairline; `PageSection divided` rules the groups inside one section; inside a detail surface use `DetailSection`. | Don't separate sections with nested `Card`s, `<hr>`, or border utility classes. |
| A section of a page | `PageSection` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Titled section with description, count and actions; sizes `lg`/`md`/`sm`. | Not for sections inside a drawer or detail tab (use `DetailSection`). |
| A section inside a detail surface | `DetailSection` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Titled block with a hairline above it (`first` suppresses the first rule); `variant="heading"` for document-like bodies. | Not for top-level page sections (use `PageSection`). |
| A section or panel header inside a page | `CardHeader` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Title + actions row with the separator under it, for a card or panel section. Use `PaneHeader` when the pane has tabs. Never hand-draw `border-b` header bands. | Not a page header (use `PageHeader` or a page template) or a channel/room header (use `ChannelHeader`). |
| A page's title row | `PageHeader` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Title, description, back link and actions at the top of a page. Templates render it for you. | Don't hand-roll an `<h1>` + flex row of buttons. |
| Buttons | `Button` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Always pass an explicit `variant` (`primary`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `danger`, `danger-solid`, `success`, `info`, `link`) and `size` where it matters. `IconButton` for icon-only actions. | Don't style a raw `<button>`, and don't rely on the default variant: one primary action per region. |
| A row's or panel's own decision | `ConfirmButton` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | A button that confirms in place: pressed, it becomes "<question?> [Confirm] [Cancel]" in the same spot (`role="group"` named by the question); Escape or Cancel restores it, Enter confirms. `tone="destructive"` for a destructive confirm; `busy` (or a promise from `onConfirm`) holds it busy. `data-confirm-state` reads `idle` / `asking` / `busy`. The replacement for `ConfirmDialog` in rows and panels: a modal is never the right place for a row's own decision. | Not for a decision that needs a body, a preview or a form: that is `ConfirmDialog`. |
| Rows with their own buttons | `GroupedList` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Pass `trailingLayout="columns"` when rows carry `actions` and/or `trailing`: the whole list becomes one grid whose actions and trailing columns are shared and right-aligned, so every row ends at one x (audit rule `row.actions-aligned`). Action Buttons draw at `sm`. | Don't leave a list of rows with different buttons in the default `inline` layout (a ragged right edge), and don't put buttons in `meta` (inside the row's button). |
| A record's inspector (the right pane) | `SubjectFrame` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | One shape for every record: title + subtitle, `PaneHeader` tabs, a hero shown whole (`SubjectHero`: an `ImageCompare` frame with `fit="contain"`, the same frame with words when there is nothing yet, the running state while a job draws it, or a host `ModelViewer`), one `KeyValue` facts table of at most eight rows, then `Disclosure`s (Request details last, collapsed). Audit rules `inspector.shape` and `subject.frame`. | Not an `EmptyState` in the hero and never a cover-cropped picture; don't stack facts under the subject by hand. |
| A pick from a grid of candidates | `SelectionBar` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Docked under the grid: the chosen thumbnail and "Selected: Concept 03", the controls that shape the pick, Clear, an optional Reject, one secondary and the one primary; Reject and Approve confirm in place (`question`, `data-action-kind`). | Don't open a dialog to approve a pick (`confirm.inline`). |
| A job that is running | `RunProgressPanel` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | One sentence, Elapsed (live from `startedAt`), Est. remaining, a `ProgressBar` when the provider reports one, Refresh status and Cancel job confirmed in place, a Non-blocking chip. With realtime-modules, `WrappedPipelineRun` draws it inside the run card. | Not a centred spinner or an `EmptyState` saying "Drawing…". |
| Empty / error / loading | `EmptyState` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | `EmptyState`, `ErrorState` and `LoadingState` for whole-region states. | Don't write "No items" paragraphs or spinners by hand. |
| Form controls | `Input` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Every control comes from `forms/`: `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`, `NumberInput`, `RadioGroup`, `Checkbox`, `Slider`, `ColorInput`, `Switch`, wrapped in `FormField` for label/help/error. | Never a raw `<input>`/`<select>`. |
| Chat | `ChatPanel` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/social` | Message list + composer. With realtime-modules, use `WrappedChatPanel` from `/integrations/realtime-modules`. | Don't hand-roll a message list. |
| Who is here | `PresenceAvatars` | `@connorhoehn/ui-components/shared` | Stacked avatars for the people in a room or document. | Don't draw avatar circles by hand (single avatar: `Avatar`). |
